desc: A grand otter-shaped tide spirit: pale white body, black void face with two small white eyes, gold crystal crown, floating violet ribbon scarf, gold rings, grandest design. Cute simple pixel art pet, chunky pixels, small chibi body, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, single dark outline, flat 2-3 tone shading, limited palette of lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold, no halo, no sparkles, no background, no ground shadow.
